head: 80d7de5cebd482d8e1f4885b85dafb2b8dc3bf25
summary: The runbook Go (cmd_go via _human_label_actor) accepts the sdlc:go label from any account that is not a bot or the automation identity, so a collaborator with only triage/label rights can make the runbook workflow run a running-system action (rollback, config change) with the runbook secrets on an incident PR the owner never approved, although decision 14 makes Go the owner's per-incident act and the comment trigger, merge step and review request all require is_owner_actor.
